par_predicate.comparison: For all five PAR rows, compare only each named byte's low six bits (value & 0x3F). PAR indices 1-4 and upper bits are intentionally not admission criteria.
par_predicate.independent_source: Pinned candidate/src/gmc_bootstrap.s and candidate/build/ladybug-gmc-boot.lst initialize PAR0=0x38, PAR5=PAR6=0x3E, PAR7=0x3F at source lines 63-72/listing lines 269-275. The approved R-I plan records the bank/page transitions: enemy source remains page 0x3E; helper-source descriptor uses page 0x24; first B080 executes LDA #$23 / STA PAR5. The receipt-pinned source/listing/map and approved runtime plan are all in source-manifest.json.
par_predicate.tolerance: Zero mismatch on the four masked register values at each checkpoint; all other byte fields are observed/retained but not gated.
